item.title: ‘This race is not about party labels’: Duncan gets endorsed by former Georgia NAACP President Woodall
item.description: Former Georgia NAACP President James Woodall, Sr. has endorsed Geoff Duncan for Governor of Georgia, citing his ability to win in November and his commitment to strategy and courage. The post ‘This race is not about party labels’: Duncan gets endorsed by former Georgia NAACP President Woodall appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘When HIStory Was Watching’ event highlights Civil Rights and legacies
item.description: At the "When HIStory Was Watching" event, Ambassador Andrew Young, Atlanta Mayor Andre Dickens, and other legacy families, archivists, and civic leaders discussed the importance of preserving and protecting civil rights archives and the legacy of Ernest C. Withers' 1.8 million images documenting the movement. The post ‘When HIStory Was Watching’ event highlights Civil Rights and legacies appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: 9to5 Georgia leads ‘Advocacy Day’ for paid leave at State Capitol
item.description: 9to5 Georgia hosted an advocacy day at the Georgia State Capitol to support paid leave, emphasizing the need for comprehensive leave policies that cover all workers and urging legislators to fund an actuarial study to explore workable solutions. The post 9to5 Georgia leads ‘Advocacy Day’ for paid leave at State Capitol appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Abortion clinics are closing, even in states that have become key access points
item.description: The number of abortion clinics in the US has decreased since the Supreme Court Dobbs decision, with 753 brick-and-mortar clinics remaining as of 2025, 54 fewer than in 2020, and even states with protective abortion policies are struggling to provide access to care. The post Abortion clinics are closing, even in states that have become key access points appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Five Stripes ready to get season started
item.description: Atlanta United players Steven Alzate and Juan Berrocal are looking forward to starting the season on the road in Cincinnati, with the team hoping to build on last year's performance and take advantage of a healthy back line and new signing Fafa Picault. item.title: A Tribute to Black Art: Music, creativity, and community action
item.description: A Tribute to Black Art is a benefit concert celebrating Black History Month through music, creativity, and collective action, with proceeds supporting Love Beyond Walls' Zion's Closet initiative to provide essential items to students and families in crisis. item.title: Traditional Ethiopian cuisine meets modern flair at Ruki’s Kitchen
item.description: Ruki's Kitchen, a pop-up turned food stall, is making waves in Atlanta's local food scene with its modern take on traditional Ethiopian cuisine, created by Chef Ali Lemma, who left his banking job to pursue his passion for cooking. item.title: ‘He’s coming here to lie’: Democratic Party of Georgia welcomes Trump to Peach State
item.description: The Democratic Party of Georgia hosted a press conference to address Donald Trump's visit to Georgia, with speakers criticizing his administration for its impact on families and the economy, and highlighting the need for a senator who will challenge the Trump administration on behalf of Georgians. item.title: Gubernatorial Forum takes place in Chamblee while Trump is in Rome
item.description: At a Democratic Gubernatorial forum in Chamblee, GA, seven candidates discussed topics ranging from education and healthcare reform to ICE's presence in Georgia and the FBI raid on the Board of Elections office, while also addressing the presence of Donald Trump in the state.
